name: ScrollArea
description: Radix ScrollArea with a custom-styled scrollbar. The root must have a bounded height or nothing scrolls.
intent: A scrollable region with a scrollbar that looks the same on every platform.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

parts.name: ScrollBar
parts.note: Rendered automatically for the vertical axis. Add explicitly with orientation="horizontal" for horizontal scrolling.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

keyboard: Arrow keys — scroll when the viewport has focus
notes: The viewport is keyboard scrollable. Radix handles the focus behaviour.
The scrollbar fades unless hovered. Some users rely on a persistent scrollbar as an affordance — consider whether that matters on your surface.
Set an explicit height on the root. Without one, the content simply grows and nothing scrolls.

agentRules: Always set an explicit height or max-height on the root.
Add ScrollBar orientation="horizontal" explicitly for horizontal scroll.
Do not wrap the whole page in a ScrollArea.

relatedComponents.note: Wrap wide tables for horizontal scroll
